tests.description: One authenticated Add Event journey follows a whitespace-only unmapped database error through the real service, store action, and form; verifies contextual fallback, retained input, retry readiness, and no failed row.

fixture_needs: Existing authenticated page and authToken from tests/support/merged-fixtures.ts
Existing interceptNetworkCall, recurse, and network monitor composition
Existing isoDateDaysFromNow from tests/support/helpers/events.ts and installed faker UUID data
summary: Generated one P1 E2E case from current source selectors. Browser observation and runtime execution were not performed because the parent preflight found Docker/Supabase unavailable. The test uses the authenticated merged page and locally fulfills only its POST; it never seeds or clears worker-pool data. The error factory intentionally keeps message present because omitted-message classification is unchanged and belongs in direct handler coverage. Rejected create has no observable store transition: enabled submit marks completion of the returned action before checking unchanged store and final UI. No response schema exists for this deliberately malformed injected error; assertions cover status, injected body, and submitted fields. No Playwright Utils deviations. HAR recorder wiring is unnecessary for this focused fault injection; normal authentication and read traffic still require the local stack.
